title: DRE timings
description: The timings file, `timings.yml`: timing names mapped to timings that any schedule can use with `timing: <name>`.

timing.description: One named timing: when it fires, in which timezone, and the dates it skips or adds.

cron.description: A cron expression (5 fields, or a macro such as `@daily`). A timing needs exactly one of `cron`, `every` or `rrule`.

every.description: Every N days, weeks or months, with exactly one unit, e.g. `{days: 3}`.

rrule.description: An iCalendar recurrence rule, e.g. `FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=2TU`. Use `starting` for a rule with `INTERVAL` above 1 or `COUNT`, and `at` for its time of day.

starting.description: With `every` or `rrule`: the first date, `YYYY-MM-DD`. `every` needs it, and so does a rule with `INTERVAL` above 1, a `COUNT`, or a day it takes from its start.

at.description: With `every` or `rrule`: the time of day, `HH:MM` (24-hour), unless the rule sets `BYHOUR`/`BYMINUTE`. Default: 00:00.

except.description: Dates (`YYYY-MM-DD`, in its timezone) it doesn't fire on, e.g. holidays.

also.description: Extra dates (`YYYY-MM-DD`) it fires on, at its time of day in its timezone. Needs a timing that fires at one time of day.

timezone.description: The timezone it fires in, an IANA name such as `Australia/Sydney`; schedules using the timing also run in it. Default: the project's `timezone:`, then UTC.
